# Vamos UI — block catalog

43 blocks — whole screens to start from. Install with `npx vamos-ui add <name>` (files land in `blocksDir/<name>/`, required components are installed too). Preview any block at https://ui.vamos.ist/view/<name>.

Pick the block whose screen is closest, then adapt the content to the real domain; do not compose a screen from scratch when a block fits. Tags: `cms`, `crm`, `hr`, `ops`, `site`, `any`.

## App shells

| Block | Screen | Use when | Avoid when | Built with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`shell-01`](https://ui.vamos.ist/blocks#shell-01) <sub>any</sub> | **Multi-app shell** — One sidebar for many apps (Site, CRM, People, Work): app switcher, section headings, inline submenus, hover flyouts, shared bottom menu, collapsible rail, and a sheet… | The default multi-app admin shell: app switcher, sections, submenus, flyouts, collapsible rail. | Apps with only a few top-level pages — use shell-03. | `app-shell`, `sidebar`, `top-bar`, `command` |
| [`shell-02`](https://ui.vamos.ist/blocks#shell-02) <sub>ops · any</sub> | **Icon rail shell** — A 64px icon rail with tooltips and flyout submenus, a top bar with search, notifications and account menu. | A compact icon-rail shell with tooltips and flyouts for dense operational tools. | Apps where labels matter for discovery — use shell-01. | `app-shell`, `sidebar`, `tooltip`, `notification-center` |
| [`shell-03`](https://ui.vamos.ist/blocks#shell-03) <sub>hr · crm · any</sub> | **Top navigation shell** — No sidebar: the app's few top-level pages sit in the top bar, with search, a New menu and the account menu. | A top-navigation shell for portals, self-service and small apps with few pages. | Apps with many sections — use shell-01. | `app-shell`, `top-bar`, `navigation-menu` |
